headline: Library Assistant
summary: Library assistant with three years at a university library in Cavite. I help students and faculty find materials, catalogue and process new books in Koha, keep circulation records accurate and encode our collection data. I enjoy making the library easier to use.

experience.title: Library Assistant
bullets: Help about 200 students a day find books, journals and online databases.
Catalogue and process around 150 new titles a month in Koha.
Keep circulation and overdue records accurate and send reminders.
Scan and index old theses for the digital repository.
Encode inventory data during the yearly collection audit.

experience.title: Student Library Assistant
bullets: Shelved returned books and assisted at the circulation desk.

education.credential: Bachelor of Library and Information Science
